name: DB Studio
description: Browse and query PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB and SQLite from Orca. Reads each worktree's .env to offer its database.

cover.alt: DB Studio inside Orca: the customers table open in the SQL editor with its result grid, and the connections panel listing the tables on the right

screenshots.alt: The DB Studio SQL editor suggesting column names for a query on the events table of a MariaDB connection
screenshots.caption: Autocomplete for tables and columns from the live schema

screenshots.alt: The New connection form in the DB Studio panel, with a connection string field and the PostgreSQL, MySQL / MariaDB and SQLite engine choices
screenshots.caption: Add a connection from a connection string or field by field

screenshots.alt: A SQL query and its result grid in DB Studio, with the connections panel beside it, in Orca's light theme
screenshots.caption: Follows Orca's active theme, light or dark

screenshots.alt: The order_totals view of a PostgreSQL connection, marked as a view in the connections panel, queried in the DB Studio SQL editor
screenshots.caption: Browse and query views, not just tables

settings.title: Connection variable
settings.description: Variable read from the worktree's .env to offer a per-worktree connection.

settings.title: Row limit
settings.description: Rows shown for a query without its own LIMIT. Results never exceed 5000 rows or about 900 KB.
